every_position_composed.reason: Site 1 frames 4 and 7 show clean transitional views of the 3D machinery without cut-off text, whereas Site 2 frame 7 awkwardly catches an unreadable, faded-out text card.

explains_the_project.reason: Both sites use the exact same 3D press, rack, and gate machinery across frames 1 to 9 to visually demonstrate how token floods are compressed into digests and anchors.

craft_of_the_3d.reason: Both sites feature identical 3D models, materials, lighting, and gridded ground planes from frame 1 through frame 9.

type_and_layout.reason: While both share the same typography and card overlap in frame 5, Site 1 avoids the nearly invisible, half-faded card text seen in Site 2 frame 7.

overall.reason: Although both sites are nearly identical builds, Site 1 has cleaner scroll transitions in frames 4 and 7 without lingering, unreadable faded-out text cards.
